entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker and member of the Gatewatch who seeks answers from Kefnet and is tormented by guilt over her past failures.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: The ibis-headed God of Knowledge of Amonkhet, corrupted by Nicol Bolas, who judges Nissa unworthy and tries to dissolve her mind.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon who has corrupted Kefnet and the other gods of Amonkhet and overwritten the plane's past.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan that took over Nissa's body on Innistrad and is now trapped in silver; Nissa's nightmare angel reminds her of it.

entities.name: The Angel of the Trial
entities.description: An illusory angel of the Trial of Knowledge, reminiscent of Emrakul, who tells Nissa to stop being a piece and be the hand that moves.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A telepath and planeswalker whose association taught Nissa to recognize mental probing.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A desert plane whose leylines are concentrated in a beautiful city behind a barrier and infected with a dark, virulent strain.

entities.name: Temple of Knowledge
entities.description: Kefnet's temple in the city, fronted by a giant ibis-headed statue, within which the Trial of Knowledge takes place.

entities.name: Trial of Knowledge
entities.description: Kefnet's trial, an illusory nightmare trap of leyline magic in a blue-lit chamber that traps unworthy initiates in eternal nightmare.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Giant alien beings whose deadening corruption Nissa compares to the blight of Amonkhet.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nissa's home plane, which she failed to protect from the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Emrakul took over Nissa's body.

entities.name: The Acolyte
entities.description: A young man in pale robes in the temple anteroom who tries to read Nissa's mind and announces the Trial of Knowledge; this page does not name him.

events.summary: Nissa wanders the beautiful, empty city and uses her mana sense to perceive the dark strain strangling Amonkhet's leylines.
events.quote: A dark virulent strain wove its way through the leylines.

events.summary: Nissa opens her eyes to find a statue of Kefnet, whose doors swing open with blue light, and she steps inside.
events.quote: a pair of large limestone doors swung open.

events.summary: A young man in the anteroom tries to probe Nissa's mind, fails, and admits she is not from here.
events.quote: You . . . you . . . are not from here,

events.summary: Nissa is struck by the fear that she herself brings the blight and failure to every plane she visits.
events.quote: She had failed to protect Zendikar. Failed to overcome Emrakul.

events.summary: The young man tells her she may attempt the Trial of Knowledge; Nissa panics, flings him against the wall, and runs into the blue light.
events.quote: she flung him against the stone walls.

events.summary: In the trial Nissa suffers a nightmare of an angel who says she can do anything, a voice she realizes was both Emrakul's and her own.
events.quote: The monster had taken over her body back on Innistrad.

events.summary: Through a cascade of nightmares, Nissa hears an inner voice telling her to stop, and realizes she is trapped in the trial's illusion.
events.quote: There had been one nightmare after another, each one cascading into the next.

events.summary: Nissa studies the leyline structure of the trap, finds a tiny gap with her eyes shut, widens it and steps through.
events.quote: In the weavings of magic surrounding her, there was a tiny gap.

events.summary: Seeing through the illusions, Nissa witnesses a vision of a dark snake's shadow swearing to drain every world, starting with Amonkhet.
events.quote: For what I require, I would drain every world.

events.summary: Nissa sees a vision of eight stars, three of which go dark, leaving a pattern like horns.
events.quote: Their new outline suggested a pair of horns.

events.summary: Visions show mummies mining blue ore, three children swallowed by the sands, a line of darkness stretching through thousands of worlds, and a golden sun disc crumbling.
events.quote: she saw an unbroken line of darkness from Amonkhet all the way back to the beginning of the line.

events.summary: The illusory angel appears, asks if Nissa is pawn or queen, and tells her to stop being a piece and be the hand that moves.
events.quote: Stop being a piece, Nissa. Be the hand that moves.

events.summary: Kefnet appears and furiously demands who mocks his trial.
events.quote: It was the god himself, Kefnet.

events.summary: Kefnet plucks Nissa's thoughts and tells her knowledge is earned, offering dissolution as kindness to the unworthy.
events.quote: Dissolution is my kindness for you.

events.summary: Nissa recognizes that Kefnet is made of corrupted leylines, and weaves a spell that adds a new fiber of mana to them, altering him so he no longer wants to destroy her.
events.quote: She pulled it, and added a new fiber of mana to its mix.

events.summary: Kefnet declares she has passed her trial and flies away.
Nissa resolves to stop being a pawn, notes the pattern she left in Kefnet, dispels the illusions, and leaves the temple.
events.quote: She was tired of being a pawn, constantly reacting to nightmares and failures, never ahead.

relations.note: Bolas has corrupted Kefnet and the other gods
relations.quote: of how he had corrupted Kefnet and the other gods

relations.note: Emrakul took over Nissa's body on Innistrad
relations.quote: The monster had taken over her body back on Innistrad.

relations.note: Kefnet tries to dissolve her mind, so she alters him to stop it
relations.quote: She had merely altered him enough to no longer want to destroy her.
Who makes a mockery of my trial?

relations.note: his essence is made of the world's corrupted leylines
relations.quote: The corrupted leylines of Amonkhet were the same strands of corruption in Kefnet
